observations: The original closed honey-wood barrel remains immediately recognizable: compact bulging staves, original planked lid organization, shoulder and two dark navy hoops. Actual E/W rotations naturally turn the lid plank divisions relative to N/S without requiring an unseen target facing.

Compared with the original, the lid retains warm honey color rather than nearly uniform lemon-yellow glare, and the lower staves stay warm and readable instead of becoming a muddy dark region. No new fine-grain noise or decorative features were introduced.

Round03 lid blocker is resolved. In the native images, the planks now have gently rounded upper/end edges and softly shaded seam margins. A restrained broad warm variation and shallow convex plank volume replace the earlier uniform cutout reading; these cues remain perceptible in the logical-size four-view and repeated previews.

Round03 hoop blocker is resolved. Both bands show a restrained lighter upper/rounded portion against a darker navy body. At logical size this reads as controlled band volume while preserving a quiet matte-to-satin character; it does not depend on a bright glossy accent.

Useful broad body faceting remains, but the colored lid, soft plank/seam depth and rounded band transition now provide visible improvement toward the frozen warm, softly lit cartoon criteria. There is no need to erase the original barrel's facets to match a smoothed photographic surface.

All four native images and the three declared previews remain clean on light, gray and dark backgrounds. No material black void, broken corner, exposed seam, clipping, bright alpha halo, muddy merged region or directional ground shadow is visible. The enlarged hoop QA image also shows continuous rounded band surfaces.

The repeated preview is consistent in scale, warmth and native facing continuation. Its individual silhouettes and wood/band separation remain readable, without a repeated defect or excess detail overwhelming the prop.

Fine wood grain, stronger blue glossy accents and the target's bright edge fringe are intentionally absent and are not needed for the intended display size.
The target's canvas/padding, internal placement and silhouette drift are not copied; native capture, dimensions and barrel construction take precedence.
